planets.title: Mercury
planets.fact: A single day (sunrise to sunrise) lasts two of its years.

planets.title: Venus
planets.fact: The hottest planet: thick clouds trap heat at about 465 °C.

planets.title: Earth
planets.fact: The only world we know with liquid oceans on its surface — and city lights on its night side.

planets.title: Mars
planets.fact: Home to Olympus Mons, a volcano nearly three times the height of Everest.

planets.title: Jupiter
planets.fact: Its Great Red Spot is a storm wider than the whole Earth.

planets.title: Saturn
planets.fact: Its rings are hundreds of thousands of km wide but mostly only tens of meters thick.

planets.title: Uranus
planets.fact: It rolls around the Sun on its side, tilted about 98°.

planets.title: Neptune
planets.fact: The windiest planet: gusts reach around 2,000 km/h.
